overview.description: The WisdomTree Core Laddered Municipal Fund (WTMU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund aims to provide federal tax-exempt current income through an actively managed portfolio of US investment grade municipal bonds. The fund seeks to maintain an average portfolio duration between four and eight years. WTMU was launched on Apr 3, 2025 and is issued by WisdomTree.
